key: So after its death must she weep,
en: So after its death must she weep,
ja: こうして　その死の後　彼女は　泣かねば　ならない

key: For it is a terrifying endeavor to face such a creature as that,
en: For it is a terrifying endeavor to face such a creature as that,
ja: そのような生き物と　対決するのは　恐ろしい試みなのだから

key: Man,
en: Man,
ja: 人間よ

key: And lose such a dear friend,
en: And lose such a dear friend,
ja: そして　そんな　大切な友を　失い

key: As a dragon,
en: As a dragon,
ja: 竜という友を

key: And finally, to have to find yet another one,
en: And finally, to have to find yet another one,
ja: そして　ついには　また別の一人を　見つけなければ　ならない

en: Who would be so willing to lock her away,
ja: 彼女を　喜んで　閉じ込めてくれる誰かを

key: And keep her safe from history, true love, and other such poisons.
en: And keep her safe from history, true love, and other such poisons.
ja: そして　歴史や　真実の愛といった　毒から　彼女を　守ってくれる誰かを。

en: After all, "Happily ever after" just means the writer stopped paying attention.
ja: 結局のところ「その後　いつまでも　幸せに」とは　作者が　気にするのを　やめただけの　ことなのだ。

key: TITANIA: Back for more?
en: TITANIA: Back for more?
ja: ティタニア: また　来たのか?

key: TITANIA: Welcome,
en: TITANIA: Welcome,
ja: ティタニア: ようこそ

key: To a free world.
en: To a free world.
ja: 自由な世界へ。

key: If you're ready to battle, go ahead and take the stand.
en: If you're ready to battle, go ahead and take the stand.
ja: バトルの準備が　できてるなら　さっさと　台に　立て。

key: TITANIA: Sooner or later it'll sink in that this just isn't a battle you'll win,
en: TITANIA: Sooner or later it'll sink in that this just isn't a battle you'll win,
ja: ティタニア: そのうち　わかるだろう　これは　あんたが　勝てるバトルじゃ　ないってことがな

ja: だから　自分のために　言っとくが:

en: Build a little bridge, and get over it.
ja: 橋でも　架けて　さっさと　乗り越えるんだな。

en: TITANIA: This will be a six-on-six Single Battle with the Alloy Badge and the Sapphire Bracelets at stake.
ja: ティタニア: これは　ごうきんバッジと　サファイアのブレスレットを　賭けた　6対6の　シングルバトルだ。

key: So you might as well just hand those over to me now.
en: So you might as well just hand those over to me now.
ja: だったら　今のうちに　それを　あたしに　渡しちまえよ。

en: I'm not going to lose after all of that,
ja: あれだけのことが　あった後で　負けるわけには　いかない

key: Which means there's no happy ending here for you.
en: Which means there's no happy ending here for you.
ja: つまり　あんたには　ハッピーエンドなんて　ないってことだ。

key: You'll just have to shuffle the cards, and deal with it.
en: You'll just have to shuffle the cards, and deal with it.
ja: カードを　切り直して　それで　なんとかするんだな。

key: Great. You won. Whatever.
en: Great. You won. Whatever.

ja: ティタニア: ああ　ああ　わかったよ。

en: TITANIA: Take your Badge.
ja: ティタニア: バッジを　受け取れ。

key: Don't feel special.
en: Don't feel special.

en: \PN received the Alloy Badge!
ja: \PNは　ごうきんバッジを　受け取った!

en: TITANIA: With that Badge, Pokémon up to level 90 will listen to you.
ja: ティタニア: そのバッジが　あれば　レベル90までの　ポケモンが　言うことを　聞くように　なる。

key: Probably.
en: Probably.
ja: たぶんな。

key: You can have this too.
en: You can have this too.
ja: これも　やるよ。

key: I guess.
en: I guess.
ja: 一応な。

en: ???: What a boring performance.

en: TITANIA: Why--
ja: ティタニア: なぜ――

key: How are you alive?
en: How are you alive?

key: You should NOT be alive right now!
en: You should NOT be alive right now!
ja: お前は　今　生きてちゃ　いけないはずだ!

en: Steel will not make me bleed.
ja: 鋼で　私が　血を流すことは　ありません。

en: And your shining armor is but tinfoil to the brimstone breath of the New World.
ja: あなたの輝くよろいなど　新世界の硫黄の吐息の前では　ただの　アルミホイル同然です。

key: But that's not really important.
en: But that's not really important.
ja: でも　そんなことは　どうでも　いいのです。

en: What's important is that \PN leaves with those Sapphire Bracelets.
ja: 重要なのは\PNが　そのサファイアのブレスレットを　持って　立ち去ることです。

key: TITANIA: Why would you need \PN to have them?
en: TITANIA: Why would you need \PN to have them?
ja: ティタニア: なんで\PNに　それを　持たせる必要が　ある?

key: TITANIA: Are you two working together?
en: TITANIA: Are you two working together?
ja: ティタニア: お前ら　二人で　組んでるのか?

key: LIN: Aren't we?
en: LIN: Aren't we?
ja: リン: 違いますか?

key: TITANIA: That doesn't make sense. You're lying.
en: TITANIA: That doesn't make sense. You're lying.
ja: ティタニア: 意味が　わからねぇ。うそを　つくな。

key: LIN: Believe whatever you want.
en: LIN: Believe whatever you want.
ja: リン: 好きなように　信じればいいでしょう。

key: That's all you've ever done anyway.
en: That's all you've ever done anyway.
ja: どのみち　あなたは　いつも　そうしてきたんですから。

key: \PN will keep the Bracelets, and your friend will keep her life.
en: \PN will keep the Bracelets, and your friend will keep her life.
ja: \PNが　ブレスレットを　持ち続ける限り　あなたの友人は　命を　保つでしょう。

en: TITANIA: Don't you dare touch her.
ja: ティタニア: 彼女に　指一本　触れるな。

key: I killed you once; I'll do it a thousand times more.
en: I killed you once; I'll do it a thousand times more.
ja: 一度　殺した　もう千回でも　殺してやる。

key: LIN: Feel free.
en: LIN: Feel free.
ja: リン: どうぞ。

key: You understand the rules.
en: You understand the rules.
ja: ルールは　わかっているはずです。

key: You could be the very reason she dies.
en: You could be the very reason she dies.
ja: 彼女が　死ぬ理由に　なるのは　あなた自身かもしれませんよ。

key: But maybe you would want that.
en: But maybe you would want that.
ja: でも　もしかしたら　それを　望んでいるのかも　しれませんね。

key: TITANIA: Don't be stupid.
en: TITANIA: Don't be stupid.
ja: ティタニア: バカを　言うな。

key: Nobody wants blood on their hands.
en: Nobody wants blood on their hands.
ja: 誰だって　自分の手を　血で　汚したくは　ない。

key: And they have nothing to gain from going after her now, but still...
en: And they have nothing to gain from going after her now, but still...
ja: それに　今　彼女を　狙ったところで　得るものなんて　ないはずだが　それでも……

key: I'm going to her.
en: I'm going to her.
ja: あたしは　彼女の元へ　行く。

key: You're coming too, until I figure out what's going on.
en: You're coming too, until I figure out what's going on.
ja: 何が　起きてるのか　わかるまでは　お前も　連れて行くぞ。

key: But I swear on everything sacred in this world,
en: But I swear on everything sacred in this world,
ja: だが　この世の　あらゆる神聖なものに　誓って言っておく

key: If you betray us, \PN, it'll be your back my blade's in next.
en: If you betray us, \PN, it'll be your back my blade's in next.
ja: もし　あたしたちを　裏切ったら\PN　次に　あたしの刃が　突き刺さるのは　お前の背中だ。

key: Let's go.
en: Let's go.
ja: 行くぞ。

key: TITANIA: What's the matter? Wet yourself from all the excitement?
en: TITANIA: What's the matter? Wet yourself from all the excitement?
ja: ティタニア: どうした?　興奮しすぎて　漏らしたか?

key: That was a joke. Please don't deign to answer.
en: That was a joke. Please don't deign to answer.
ja: 冗談だ。わざわざ　答えなくて　いいぞ。

key: TITANIA: We're doing this again?
en: TITANIA: We're doing this again?
ja: ティタニア: また　これを　やるのか?

key: TITANIA: That woman is dead, but I don't feel good about it...
en: TITANIA: That woman is dead, but I don't feel good about it...
ja: ティタニア: あの女は　死んだが　いい気分は　しないな……

key: That boy may have been on their side, but why was he--
en: That boy may have been on their side, but why was he--
ja: あのガキは　あいつらの側だったのかも　しれないが　なんで　あんな――

key: It has to have been something she did.
en: It has to have been something she did.
ja: きっと　あの女が　何か　やったに違いない。

key: Everything is her fault.
en: Everything is her fault.
ja: 全部　あの女の　せいだ。

key: Sometimes I think Amy is lucky to be able to forget.
en: Sometimes I think Amy is lucky to be able to forget.
ja: 時々　忘れられるエイミーは　運がいいと　思うことが　あるよ。

key: But you're here for the Gym Battle, aren't you?
en: But you're here for the Gym Battle, aren't you?
ja: でも　ジムバトルに　来たんだろ?

key: Are we doing that now?
en: Are we doing that now?
ja: 今から　やるのか?

key: TITANIA: Rematches like this are pointless.
en: TITANIA: Rematches like this are pointless.
ja: ティタニア: こういう再戦って　意味がないんだよな。

key: You're just going to keep losing.
en: You're just going to keep losing.
ja: あんたは　どうせ　負け続けるだけだ。

key: And let's get this over with.
en: And let's get this over with.
ja: さっさと　済ませちまおう。

key: TITANIA: Right...
en: TITANIA: Right...
ja: ティタニア: そうだな……

key: Okay, this will be a six-on-six Single Battle with the Alloy Badge and the Sapphire Bracelets at stake.
en: Okay, this will be a six-on-six Single Battle with the Alloy Badge and the Sapphire Bracelets at stake.
ja: よし　これは　ごうきんバッジと　サファイアのブレスレットを　賭けた　6対6の　シングルバトルだ。

key: I really don't feel like losing after all of what just happened.
en: I really don't feel like losing after all of what just happened.
ja: さっきの　あれこれの後で　負ける気分には　全然　なれないんでな。

key: We're not at the happy ending.
en: We're not at the happy ending.
ja: あたしたちは　ハッピーエンドに　いるわけじゃない。

key: There is no such thing.
en: There is no such thing.
ja: そんなもの　最初から　ないんだ。

key: That's why I have to keep fighting.
en: That's why I have to keep fighting.
ja: だから　あたしは　戦い続けなきゃ　ならない。

key: Tch. Whatever.
en: Tch. Whatever.
ja: ちっ。どうでもいいさ

key: TITANIA: Today is not my day.
en: TITANIA: Today is not my day.
ja: ティタニア: 今日は　あたしの日じゃ　なかったな。

key: TITANIA: You did save my life just then, so...
en: TITANIA: You did save my life just then, so...
ja: ティタニア: さっき　あたしの命を　救ってくれたんだから……

key: Thanks.
en: Thanks.
ja: 感謝する。

key: That's why you made me kill that boy.
en: That's why you made me kill that boy.
ja: だから　あんたは　あたしに　あのガキを　殺させたんだな。

key: TITANIA: Ironic.
en: TITANIA: Ironic.
ja: ティタニア: 皮肉な話だ。

key: I asked if you would trust me, but it turns out I'm the one who can't trust you.
en: I asked if you would trust me, but it turns out I'm the one who can't trust you.
ja: あんたを　信じられるかって　聞いたのに　結局　あたしの方が　あんたを　信じられなかったってわけだ。

key: And yet I don't have a choice but to.
en: And yet I don't have a choice but to.
ja: それでも　信じるしか　ないんだが。

key: \PN, mark my words:
en: \PN, mark my words:
ja: \PN　よく　覚えとけ:

key: If you betray us, or if anything happens to Amaria,
en: If you betray us, or if anything happens to Amaria,
ja: あたしたちを　裏切ったり　アマリアに　何か　あったりしたら

key: It'll be your back my blade's in next.
en: It'll be your back my blade's in next.
ja: 次に　あたしの刃が　突き刺さるのは　お前の背中だ。

key: TITANIA: I'm going to go deal with that boy downstairs.
en: TITANIA: I'm going to go deal with that boy downstairs.
ja: ティタニア: あたしは　下に　いる　あのガキの　始末を　つけてくる。

key: What happened to him is my responsibility.
en: What happened to him is my responsibility.
ja: あいつに　起きたことは　あたしの責任だ。

key: Once that's done, I'll meet you at Amy's house.
en: Once that's done, I'll meet you at Amy's house.
ja: それが　終わったら　エイミーの家で　会おう。

key: Go without me.
en: Go without me.
ja: 先に　行っててくれ。

key: TITANIA: Fine by me.
en: TITANIA: Fine by me.

en: I could use a break after all that bullshit.

key: A faint light can be seen at the bottom.
en: A faint light can be seen at the bottom.
ja: 底の方に　かすかな光が　見える。

key: Jump?
en: Jump?
ja: 飛び降りますか?

key: Why not?
en: Why not?
ja: いいでしょう?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
